honest: The prior reading of every ratcheted measure, with the cause and the evidence for it. A reading is a MEASUREMENT of this repository, not a theorem: it is contingent, it is superseded by the next reading, and nothing can be derived from it — so it is sealed by content-address here rather than minted into the proof ledger. A raise with no cause or no evidence is refused outright, which is strictly more friction than the numeral it replaces: `<prefix>_<value>` went green with no reason recorded anywhere.
